explanation: The drafters of the convention of 1950 said they meant it as a warning. After February 1948 the Council of Europe’s lawyers asked how a democracy could be warned that it was being taken over from inside by constitutional means, which is what had just happened in Czechoslovakia. That is why the list of rights is short, classical and political, and why the convention provides for enforcement by the members together, against a state that will not police itself. The claim is about why the convention was drafted and the shape that gave it. The convention was also the European answer to the Universal Declaration of the year before.
